name: data-search
description: Search local files, document contents and read-only database sources using MCP.

interface.shortDescription: Find local files and source-backed content.
interface.longDescription: Connect to an installed data_search service for keyword and local semantic search. Run the bundled installer first; it writes an absolute MCP command into the installed plugin copy.
